content.value_statement: Incident reviews often lose key facts or produce vague follow-up work. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through timelines, root cause analysis, meetings, and action items.
actual_capabilities: Provides a full postmortem template with summary, impact, timeline, root cause analysis, and action items.
Guides 5 Whys analysis with evidence, contributing factors, and systemic improvements.
Offers a quick postmortem format for minor incidents.
Structures postmortem meetings with timed discussion sections and facilitation prompts.
Lists best practices and anti-patterns for blameless incident reviews.
limitations: Does not collect incident data automatically.
Does not verify metrics, logs, ticket status, or customer impact.
Requires users to supply accurate timelines, evidence, and ownership details.
Does not replace legal, compliance, or security review.

use_cases.title: Document a Production Outage
use_cases.description: Create a clear postmortem after a severe service incident with impact, timeline, causes, and follow-up work.

use_cases.title: Turn Reviews Into Action Items
use_cases.description: Convert lessons learned into owned tasks with priority, due dates, and measurable prevention goals.

use_cases.title: Facilitate a Blameless Meeting
use_cases.description: Run a structured review that keeps discussion focused on evidence, system conditions, and learning.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Postmortem
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a single incident summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the postmortem-writing skill. Draft a blameless postmortem for this incident: [summary]. Include impact, timeline, root cause, and action items.

prompt_templates.title: Build a 5 Whys Analysis
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for root cause exploration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the 5 Whys template for this incident: [facts]. For each why, include evidence and separate proximate causes from systemic causes.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Review Meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60 minute postmortem meeting plan for this incident: [details]. Include agenda timing, discussion prompts, risks, and expected outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Improve the Postmortem Program
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for recurring incident patterns.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these postmortems: [summaries]. Identify repeated failure modes, weak action items, ownership gaps, and the highest value process improvements.

output_examples.input: A payment outage lasted 47 minutes after a deployment changed database connection behavior.
output_examples.output: A postmortem draft with a UTC timeline, customer impact, connection pool root cause, detection gaps, and owned prevention tasks.

output_examples.input: A minor cache incident caused high API latency for 12 minutes.
output_examples.output: A quick postmortem that summarizes the cache miss storm, immediate mitigation, long-term fix, and lesson learned.

output_examples.input: Three recent incidents show slow detection and weak follow-up ownership.
output_examples.output: A pattern review that highlights recurring detection gaps, improves action item quality, and recommends process changes.

best_practices: Collect exact times, customer impact, and evidence before drafting.
Phrase causes as system conditions instead of individual blame.
Turn lessons into owned tickets with due dates.
anti_patterns: Writing a blame document focused on individual mistakes.
Publishing vague action items without owners or dates.
Skipping minor incidents that reveal repeat patterns.

faq.question: Does this skill write a full postmortem?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides templates for standard, 5 Whys, and quick postmortem documents.

faq.question: Does it gather data from incident tools?
faq.answer: No. You must provide logs, metrics, timelines, and ticket links.

faq.question: Can it support blameless reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes system conditions, evidence, and learning instead of individual blame.

faq.question: Does it include meeting guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides a 60 minute structure for postmortem review meetings.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it enough for security incidents?
faq.answer: It can structure the document, but sensitive details need security, legal, and compliance review.
